# Lidarr fixtures: synthesized, unverified

No live Lidarr was available. These files are hand-built from Lidarr's published OpenAPI
document (`src/Lidarr.Api.V1/openapi.json`, develop branch) and the Servarr wiki, trimmed to the
fields Hearer reads. They have **not** been compared with responses from a running Lidarr.
When one is available, record real responses over these files and drop this notice
(see docs/ADAPTERS.md, "Fulfillment: Lidarr").
